reasons: Claimed status is 'compliant' and the cited paragraphs support it: Section 1(a) engages Contractor 'on a task by task basis' under separately negotiated SOWs with no requirements commitment, minimum volume, or covenant barring Customer from using third-party providers.

The three 'exclusive' hits are correctly characterised as non-exclusive-dealing: IP ownership allocation (p0020), a non-exclusive licence granted to Customer (p0021), and entire-agreement boilerplate (p0051) — none imposes exclusivity on Customer.

Consistent with a compliant finding, the redline is identical to the original text and no counterparty comment was proposed; the deterministic check confirms no sole-supplier/requirements obligation remains.
Rationale appropriately defers the mutual non-solicitation (p0047) to a separate rule, avoiding double-flagging the same term.
